gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Sharp and squared-off, Oxanium draws every curve with one unbroken line, while Noto Sans Deseret sits beneath it with a tall, wide-looking lowercase.. Each one holds its own.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Oxanium's lines look drawn with a pencil that never presses harder. Noto Sans Duployan takes the opposite job, giving the body a wide-mouthed a and generous counters while the heading supplies the swagger.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Oxanium holds one fixed nib throughout. It gives headings a commanding, uniform stroke, while Noto Sans Elbasan handles the text with large lowercase forms and terminals that stay open.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Rounded-rod letters with real attitude lead the way here, and Oxanium keeps every stroke at a single weight. Noto Sans Elymaic follows with open apertures and low ascenders, handling the reading while the heading handles the first impression.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Oxanium builds every stem, bowl and tail like rope. Noto Sans Georgian runs beneath it in a plain sans with open curves and short ascenders, so paragraphs feel modern, clean and easy to move through.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Even its diagonals carry the same heft as the stems in Oxanium, which gives the heading a bold, engineered look. Noto Sans Glagolitic reads sturdy and approachable, with round letters that stay clear.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-jp: Oxanium has a hard, single-weight edge that grabs attention at once, and Noto Sans JP gives it a very tall x-height with curves that sweep open. Their shared tall lowercase is the strongest link.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi fills the line with lowercase forms that look nearly like capitals, and its e keeps an open channel. Oxanium brings uninterrupted monoline strokes to the headline, but the body font does the quiet work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Oxanium has a tube-like stroke that looks like neon glass, with curves ending in clear daylight. Noto Sans Kayah Li sits quietly below as a plain sans, so the glow stays in the heading.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase in every line, with curves that never close on themselves. Oxanium brings commanding, stress-free curves to the heading, but this body font supplies the weight.
